body:
We spoke back in July about the Application Engineer role in Rochester. I wanted to get back in touch about a different opening.

Actalent has an Embedded Firmware Engineer role in Goleta covering motor controller and generator control work, and it sits much closer to what I actually build. You already have my resume from July.

Since aerospace and defense is your desk, are you the one working that requisition, or is there someone else at Actalent I should be speaking with about it?
hook_used: Existing warm LinkedIn thread (she cold DMed him in July) plus her Aerospace and Defense desk matching the Goleta req
